title: CRC metagenome transferability: R2 code with four-definition prediction extension
description: R2 reproducibility workflows, plus a portable four-definition prediction extension for training-only selection, fixed Elastic Net/Random Forest fitting, locked external prediction, tie-aware AUROC/AP summaries, membership and direction audits, Figure 8 and supplementary TSV generation. The extension is post-outcome sensitivity, not untouched confirmatory validation. No full model refitting or fresh-network environment replay was performed for this packaging release. Unchanged third-party ENA metadata snapshots for PRJNA447983 and PRJEB27928 retain their source attribution and retrieval sidecars; the MIT license applies to software, not third-party data. No raw reads, abundance matrices, per-participant prediction tables, model binaries or credentials are included in the new extension.
